question: Who among the following has been named as the World Bank Education Advisor for the period of June 2021 to June 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ranjitsinh Disale**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ranjitsinh Disale:-**

 
 
• Ranjitsinh Disale has been appointed as the World Bank Education Advisor for the period June 2021 to June 2024.
 
• He is a government school primary teacher from Maharashtra's Solapur.
 
• He has also won the Global Teacher Prize 2020.
 
• He’s been honoured for “transforming the life chances” of girls at Zilla Parishad Primary School in Paritewadi – a poor village in Maharashtra state where tribal communities have traditionally kept females away from formal education.
 
• The Global Teacher Prize, which has been referred to by journalists as the Nobel Prize for teaching, highlights and celebrates the profession while giving greater recognition to the work of teachers all over the world. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Peter Tabichi:-**

 
 
• He is a Kenyan science teacher and Franciscan friar who gained international recognition for his exceptional contributions to education.
 
• He was awarded the Global Teacher Prize in 2019, which is a prestigious award presented annually to an outstanding teacher who has made a significant impact on their students and community.
 
 
 
• **Vishwavir Ahuja:-**
 
 
• Vishwavir Ahuja is an Indian business executive and banker.
 
• He is known for his role as the Managing Director and CEO of RBL Bank (Ratnakar Bank Limited), a private sector bank in India.
 
• Ahuja has been associated with RBL Bank for a significant period and has played a key role in the bank's growth and transformation.
